subtasks.title: Implement oversized test_spec_refs warning check (group-level)
details: In `packages/afspec/afspec/validation.py`, add a helper `_check_group_test_spec_refs(group) -> list[ValidationWarning]`.
Sum `len(subtask.test_spec_refs or [])` for all non-verification subtasks (subtask IDs not ending in `.V`).
If sum > 15, emit a `ValidationWarning(message=f"Group {group.id} has {total} test_spec_refs (limit 15)", entity_id=str(group.id))`.
Apply to all `kind` values — do not filter by `kind`.
If the group has no subtasks or no `test_spec_refs`, the sum is 0 and no warning is emitted.
Call this helper from `validate()` and append results to the warnings list.

subtasks.title: Implement too-many-subtasks warning check (group-level)
details: Add a helper `_check_group_subtask_count(group) -> list[ValidationWarning]`.
Count non-verification subtasks: those whose `id` does NOT end with `.V`.
If count > 6, emit `ValidationWarning(message=f"Group {group.id} has {count} subtasks (limit 6, excluding verification)", entity_id=str(group.id))`.
Exactly one warning per group that exceeds the limit.
Call from `validate()` and append results to the warnings list.

subtasks.title: Implement single-subtask overload warning check
details: Add a helper `_check_subtask_overload(group) -> list[ValidationWarning]`.
For each non-verification subtask, count `len(subtask.test_spec_refs or [])`.
If count > 8, emit `ValidationWarning(message=f"Subtask {subtask.id} references {count} test_spec_refs (limit 8)", entity_id=subtask.id)`.
Subtasks with missing or empty `test_spec_refs` count as 0 — no warning.
Call from `validate()` and append results to the warnings list.

This rule applies regardless of whether other splitting thresholds are exceeded.'

subtasks.title: Add grouping strategy and ID renumbering rules to prompt
details: Add Rule 4 — grouping by requirement: 'When splitting, group subtasks by the requirement they trace to. Each resulting group covers a distinct set of requirements. Add Rule 6 — ID renumbering: 'Non-test groups shift their IDs to follow the last test group. Subtask IDs within each group use the `{group_id}.{N}` format.'
